title: Home Mortgage Loans Forbearance Schedule: Plan Length Limits and Eligible Hardships by Program
content:
The Loss Mitigation desk works the Home Mortgage Loans forbearance figures from this schedule: the longest first plan a program allows, the longest total forbearance over the life of the loan, and the hardship types the program treats as eligible.

| Program | Longest first plan | Longest total forbearance over the life of the loan |
|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 6 months | 12 months |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 6 months | 12 months |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 3 months | 12 months |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 3 months | 12 months |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 3 months | 12 months |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 3 months | 6 months |

## Eligible hardships

| Program | Eligible hardship types |
|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | involuntary job loss, medical, natural disaster, death of a co-borrower, military deployment |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | involuntary job loss, medical, natural disaster, death of a co-borrower, military deployment |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | involuntary job loss, medical, natural disaster, death of a co-borrower, military deployment |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | involuntary job loss, medical, natural disaster, death of a co-borrower, military deployment |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | involuntary job loss, medical, natural disaster, death of a co-borrower, military deployment |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | involuntary job loss, medical, natural disaster, death of a co-borrower |

## Notes to the schedule

The two agency programs allow the longest first plan at 6 months; the Conventional programs and the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage allow 3 months, as does the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage.

Five of the programs allow 12 months of forbearance in total over the life of the loan. The Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage allows 6 months, which is also the figure at which its total limit and the longest first plan of the agency programs happen to meet.

Five programs treat the same five hardship types as eligible. The Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage treats four of them as eligible and does not carry military deployment in its list.
